review_candidates.title: Network Architect
review_candidates.description: About Us Join us at Orange Business! We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business. Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities. About The Role Architecture & Design Lead the design and architecture of large-scale network and infrastructure solutions, covering data centres, cloud, security, and connectivity. Define end-to-end NAC strategies for secure access management. Ensure designs align with organizational security, compliance, and availability requirements. Prepare and review HLD (High-Level Design), LLD (Low-Level Design), and other architecture artefacts Implementation & Integration Lead deployments and integrations of enterprise-grade network and data centre solutions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate networking with security, virtualisation, cloud, and application layers. Drive automation, standardization, and introduce best practices in network design, cloud adoption, security frameworks, and automation.. Optimization & Operations Conduct capacity planning, performance tuning, and lifecycle management across network and data centre environments. Provide escalation support for complex issues in WAN, LAN, Wireless, Data Centre, and NAC domains. Perform risk assessments and propose mitigation strategies. Governance & Strategy Develop network and data centre roadmaps and reference architectures. Evaluate emerging technologies and vendors (Cisco, Aruba, Juniper, etc.) to align with business needs. Contribute to security strategy by integrating NAC and related access security mechanisms About You Technical & Functional Skills & Certifications BE / B.tech/ B.Sc. in EXTC/ Computer Science / Information Technology CCIE Enterprise/Data Center, Aruba ACDX, JNCIE-DC/ENT, CISSP Experience : 15+ years of networking experience with at least 3+ years in an architect-level role Core Networking: Strong hands-on experience in WAN technologies (SD-WAN, MPLS, routing protocols). Expertise in LAN architecture (switching, segmentation, high availability). Advanced Wireless design and deployment (Wi-Fi 5/6, controllers, cloud-managed). Proven experience in NAC solutions (Cisco ISE, Aruba ClearPass, Juniper Access Assurance or equivalent). Hands-on experience designing, integrating, and troubleshooting across Cisco, Aruba, and Juniper ecosystems. Ability to design vendor-agnostic reference architectures, ensuring interoperability and flexibility. Data Centre Networking: Expertise in Data Centre fabric technologies (Cisco ACI, VXLAN/EVPN, Juniper Apstra, Aruba CX fabric). Strong knowledge of virtualisation and integration with hypervisors (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM). Understanding of hybrid cloud connectivity (AWS, Azure, GCP interconnects). Familiarity with storage networking (SAN, iSCSI, FCoE) and redundancy models Security Knowledge: Understanding of network security fundamentals (firewalls, VPNs, segmentation, ZTNA concepts). Familiarity with OEM security features in Cisco, Aruba, and Juniper ecosystems. Additional Competencies: Network automation and programmability (Python, Ansible, APIs). Strong documentation, solution presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills. Ability to lead design workshops and mentor technical teams. You bring passion, energy, taste for exploration and adaptability. You seek the opportunity to expand your knowledge and develop new skills. What We Offer Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world. Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working). Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities. Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange. Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events. Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards. Only Your Skills Matter Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

You will support the implementation of continuous improvement projects and processes. Escalate to L3 (or Security/Identity) for structural defects, design/policy changes, exceptions (e.g., Conditional Access), or recurring issues requiring engineering remediation. Clear communication with L1, L3, and stakeholders; structured documentation and follow-up. Fluent in English. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process. Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption. Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs). Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance. Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists. Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks. Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training. Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work. Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities. Embodies our culture and values. Qualifications Required Qualifications : High school diploma, GED, or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND experience supporting IT equipment or related technology. While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications: Experience supporting IT equipment or related technology. Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC). review_candidates.description: 三菱重工グループは、エンジニアリングとものづくりのグローバルリーダーとして、 1884年の創立以来、社会課題に真摯に向き合い、人々の暮らしを支えてきました。 長い歴史の中で培われた高い技術力に最先端の知見を取り入れ、 カーボンニュートラル社会実現に向けたエナジートランジション、社会インフラのスマート化、サイバー・セキュリティ分野の発展に取り組み、人々の豊かな暮らしを実現します。 募集背景 当社では、最新鋭の環境負荷低減技術を装備する次世代型の大型フェリー、調査船、官公庁船などの引き合いが増えています。 事業規模を拡大していくなかで、共に工程から品質管理までを担当いただく造船エンジニアを募集します。 業務内容 工事担当としてブロック組立/溶接ステージの工程・品質管理 （変更の範囲） 三菱造船（株）及び三菱重工業（株）の定める業務全般 ※将来的に三菱造船のみならず、三菱重工業の業務への変更を命ずる可能性があります。 仕事の魅力・やりがい 工事担当として組織運営の一端を担う責任もありますが、造船はスケールも大きく、自身が携わった、担当した"モノづくり"が目の前で船として形となり進水していく姿を見る感動はひとしおです。 私たちと一緒にお客様に喜ばれる製品を造っていきましょう。 紹介記事・動画・インタビュー 三菱造船が未来を拓く Spectra by 三菱重工 https://spectra.mhi.com/jp/energy-transition/launching-the-future-at-mitsubishi-shipbuilding 取締役社長 上田 伸 三菱造船紹介動画 https://youtu.be/g0AfnQcCv7U 三菱造船のカタログ・動画 https://www.mhi.com/jp/group/mhimsb/MovieBrochure 社員インタビュー 全社一丸となって「エナジートランジション」時代に挑む──船舶設計者の新たな挑戦 https://www.talent-book.jp/mhi/stories/58481 変化する社会課題の解決に挑む──新人エンジニアが描く未来の航路 https://www.talent-book.jp/mhi/stories/58675 学び続けられる場所を求めて辿り着いた場所──三菱造船で叶える「ものづくりの夢」 https://www.talent-book.jp/mhi/stories/59268 アルミ船造りでオールマイティな技術と視野を磨く。若き職人が貫く「後悔のない生き方」 https://www.talent-book.jp/mhi/stories/62187 必要な知識・能力・経験 必須 ・溶接品質に関する知識 ・造船会社もしくはプラント・機械装置メーカーでの勤務経験 ・工程管理業務経験もしくは品質管理業務経験 求める人物像 ・協調性がある方 ・やり遂げる力のある方 福利厚生 休日休暇：年間休日127日 ・完全週休2日制（土・日） ・祝日、年末年始、夏季休暇、年次有給休暇（最大22日／年）、結婚休暇、出産休暇、忌引き休暇 等 ・勤務地により休日の振替有 通勤手当：あり 住居手当：あり （家賃補助制度のほか、寮・社宅完備） 家族手当：あり 社会保険：雇用保険、労災保険、健康保険、厚生年金保険 福利厚生：住宅融資、育児・介護休業制度、確定拠出年金制度など 職種 / 募集ポジション 【三菱重工/三菱造船（下関）】造船工作部 船殻課（下関） 雇用形態 正社員 給与 応相談 勤務地 750-8505 山口県下関市彦島江の浦町6丁目16-1 地図で確認 （雇入れ直後） 山口県下関市 （変更の範囲） 三菱造船（株）及び三菱重工業（株）の国内外拠点 雇用形態 三菱重工業に入社後、事業会社（三菱造船（株））に在籍出向という雇用形態になります。 入社後の給与水準や福利厚生、勤務体系等は三菱重工業の社員と同一です。

review_candidates.description: Crosslinked Jobs/Thermoplastics/Tooling Engineer/Project Manager MP Tooling Engineer/Project Manager Michael Page Akron, OHtodayverified 7 h ago $120k Manage injection mold design, procurement, and qualification for custom molding programs. Apply Apply Seniority Mid-level Work On-site Type Full-time Degree BS Experience 3–6 yrs Industry General manufacturing Role Process Engineering Materials thermoplastic resins3engineered resins1 Techniques Mold Flow Analysis16 Role details This Tool Engineer / Project Manager role combines injection mold engineering expertise with end-to-end project management responsibility for new and existing customer programs. The position serves as the primary technical liaison between customers, suppliers, and internal teams, overseeing mold design, procurement, qualification, APQP activities, engineering changes, and project execution to ensure programs are delivered on time, within budget, and to quality requirements. Client Details Our client is a privately held U.S.-based manufacturer specializes in custom injection molding and full-service contract manufacturing for OEM customers across a wide range of industries, including medical devices, industrial equipment, automotive components, electronics, and automation systems. The company is known for its engineering expertise, ISO 9001-certified quality standards, comprehensive production capabilities-from design and tooling through molding, assembly, finishing, and testing-and its commitment to delivering complex manufacturing solutions that improve customer efficiency, quality, and speed to market. Description Evaluate customer products and part designs to identify manufacturability concerns, tooling risks, cost-reduction opportunities, and methods to improve quality and shorten lead times. Review and approve injection mold designs to ensure compliance with customer requirements, engineering specifications, and internal design standards. Schedule, facilitate, and lead project review meetings while maintaining overall oversight of project activities, deliverables, and milestones. Collaborate with tooling suppliers to manage the design, development, modification, and approval of injection molds, from concept through production release. Partner with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and administrative teams to support operational objectives and successful program launches. Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and suppliers, ensuring project deadlines, quality expectations, and performance objectives are consistently achieved. Utilize ERP, APQP, and project management systems to communicate project status, track progress, and maintain detailed project schedules and timelines. Develop customer quotations, cost analyses, tooling budgets, and subcontractor estimates for new tooling programs and tooling transfers. Manage project financial performance, including budget tracking, cost control, forecasting, and profitability analysis. Monitor and control project scope changes, ensuring schedule impacts, costs, and risks are appropriately documented, communicated, and resolved. Proactively identify project risks and issues, develop mitigation plans, resolve competing priorities, and escalate concerns when necessary. Coordinate all aspects of engineering changes and customer-driven modifications, including impacts to cost, quality, timing, and delivery commitments. Create and maintain project documentation, order entry records, and electronic project files throughout the program lifecycle. Ensure successful completion of tooling programs, including mold qualifications, tryouts, validation activities, and first article inspections. Coordinate procurement activities, supplier engagements, raw material requirements, and outside services to support project schedules and delivery commitments. Support additional engineering, project management, and continuous improvement initiatives as required. Profile Bachelor's degree in Plastics Engineering, Polymer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline; equivalent experience in mold making, mold design, or tooling engineering may be considered. Minimum of 6 years of experience in tooling engineering, mold making, or mold design within the plastics injection molding industry; alternatively, a relevant engineering degree and 3+ years of applicable experience. Strong knowledge of injection mold design, mold construction, thermoplastic and engineered resin materials, injection molding equipment, and molding processes. Experience using 3D CAD software for product and tooling design, with SolidWorks experience preferred. Hands-on experience performing and interpreting Mold Flow Analysis (MFA) to support tooling and process development. Demonstrated ability to manage technical projects from concept through production launch, including schedule, budget, and risk management responsibilities. Familiarity with formal project management methodologies and project management software preferred. Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent) preferred. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional internal teams. Strong understanding of quality principles, continuous improvement methodologies, and manufacturing best practices. Commitment to delivering high-quality products, minimizing waste and production defects, and ensuring customer satisfaction. Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and drive projects to successful completion with minimal supervision. Your role will include delivering technical trainings in various formats—from on-site customer visits and small group sessions to larger conference-style presentations. You will cover battery technologies, diagnostics, fitting instructions, and vehicle electronics systems, while also creating training materials and technical documentation. In addition, you will perform product demonstrations and trials, manage technical and warranty queries, and support customers in handling claims from their end users. At Clarios, your passion, ingenuity and grit are celebrated. Here, you can get out what you put in. Our benefits philosophy reflects our commitment to care for our employees and rewarding their dedication, expertise and commitment. About Clarios Clarios is the global leader in advanced, low-voltage battery technologies for mobility. Our batteries and smart solutions power nearly every type of vehicle and are found in 1 of 3 cars on the road today. With around 18,000 employees in over 100 countries, we bring deep expertise to our Aftermarket and OEM partners, and reliability, safety and comfort to everyday lives. We answer to the planet with a rigorous sustainability focus – advancing best-in-class sustainability practices and advocating for them across our industry. review_candidates.title: Structural Senior Project Associate
review_candidates.description: ECS is seeking a Structural Senior Project Associate to join our Mid-Atlantic Building Science + Infrastructure team in Baltimore, MD. In this role, you will manage structural engineering and consulting projects and serve as a lead technical consultant on structural investigations, assessments, testing, repair design, and construction administration services. You will work closely with clients and multidisciplinary project teams to evaluate existing structures, investigate performance concerns, support rehabilitation and restoration projects, and deliver practical consulting solutions across a variety of facility types. This is a client-facing role with daily interaction with clients, architects, contractors, engineers, and owners. The position involves significant responsibility for project management, technical execution, business development, and mentorship of junior staff within a collaborative consulting environment. Responsibilities Technical & Field Work Perform structural engineering, assessment, testing, and consulting services. Conduct field investigations, structural assessments, and condition evaluations of existing structures. Interpret drawings, calculations, specifications, and field data; perform or oversee drafting and design activities as needed. Develop testing plans and direct specialized structural testing programs. Interpret testing results, identify deficiencies, and recommend corrective actions and repair solutions. Perform structural investigations, forensic assessments, and condition studies. Perform structural design, repair design, rehabilitation design, and peer review of calculations, drawings, specifications, and submittals. Maintain knowledge of applicable building codes, standards, regulations, and industry best practices related to structural engineering and consulting. Project Management Manage structural engineering and consulting projects from setup through completion. Coordinate project teams and direct site activities with field staff, subcontractors, and senior managers. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining schedule, scope, and budget objectives. Prepare and review proposals, change orders, budgets, and invoices. Monitor project progress and communicate schedule updates, field activities, and potential budget impacts. Communicate project milestones with clients and advise on significant project changes. Client Interaction & Business Development Interface with clients regularly and lead project meetings and discussions. Present testing results, project findings, and recommendations to clients. Maintain and develop client relationships and support growth of the client database. Support marketing and business development efforts within the structural consulting practice. Team Leadership & Collaboration Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on project execution. Mentor junior staff and supervise personnel performing field investigations, testing, assessments, and design activities. Coordinate staffing needs with other managers to support project execution. Provide technical guidance and training to junior engineers and field staff. Documentation & Reporting Prepare structural engineering reports, perform analysis, and provide recommendations. Ensure reports meet professional standards for clarity, accuracy, and technical content. Review and approve reports, calculations, and deliverables prepared by junior staff prior to Principal review. Lead discussions with clients regarding findings, conclusions, and recommended actions. Additional Responsibilities Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications Education & Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Architectural Engineering. 5+ years of related experience. Professional Engineer (P.E.) license preferred or ability to obtain. Knowledge & Skills Strong knowledge of building science, building enclosure systems, and construction practices. Strong knowledge of building codes, materials, and structural or architectural systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong project management and consulting skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and lead multidisciplinary teams. Strong judgment, critical thinking, and decision-making abilities. Physical Requirements Ability to lift up to 40 pounds multiple times per day, stand for extended periods, walk on uneven terrain, and perform work at heights. Additional Requirements Valid driver’s license required if driving for or on behalf of an ECS subsidiary. Why Join ECS? Nationwide Building Science + Infrastructure Consulting practice made up of more than 180 employees with deep technical expertise and opportunities for collaboration across the country Opportunity to lead high-profile projects with technical complexity and visibility Be part of a growing and innovative team focused on technical excellence and client service Supportive work environment that values expertise, collaboration, and continuous learning Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and comprehensive benefits ECS is an employee-owned company with an Employee Stock Ownership program (ESOP)! 401(k) with up to 4% match Tuition Assistance Program And more! The expected pay range for this role and location is $105k - $150k/year. The final agreed-upon compensation will be determined based on specific location and other individual qualifications. ECS Core Values: Collaborate, Focus & Lead ECS Group of Companies (ECS) was founded in 1988 with the goal to raise the standards of professional engineering consulting. Today, we are a leader in geotechnical, construction materials, environmental and facilities consulting services. We are employee-owned with more than 3,000 employees in 100+ offices and testing facilities coast to coast. ECS is currently ranked #60 in Engineering News-Record’s Top 500 Design Firms (April 2026), #148 in Engineering News-Record’s Top 200 Environmental Firms (October 2025) and #50 in Zweig Group’s Hot Firm List (May 2025). For additional information about ECS, visit: www.ecslimited.com. ECS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. To learn more, click here.

review_candidates.title: Service Delivery Lead
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Service Delivery Manager – Managed Print Services (MPS) Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates Experience: 5-8 years About the Company We provide Managed Print Services that help organizations operate reliable, cost-controlled and measurable printing environments across distributed locations. Our work combines print and imaging technology, field service, helpdesk support, consumables fulfilment, fleet monitoring and commercial contract management to keep customer operations running with minimal disruption. Our teams work across customer sites, branch locations and operational support functions, partnering with major OEMs and internal Sales, Finance and Supply Chain stakeholders. We focus on dependable service delivery, accurate billing, responsive escalation management and continuous improvement because these levers protect customer trust, contract revenue and long-term account value. We are building a service culture that values ownership, clear communication, data-led decisions and practical problem-solving. The successful candidate will join a customer-focused environment where strong operational execution directly supports retention, profitability, renewals and growth. The role is based in Dubai and includes regular travel to customer and branch locations. About the Role The Service Delivery Manager owns end-to-end operational performance across the assigned Managed Print Services install base. Through field service, helpdesk, consumables, monitoring tools and escalation controls, the role protects device uptime, SLA compliance, billing accuracy and customer satisfaction. Reporting to the General Manager – Revenue & Service Delivery, the manager leads service delivery teams and coordinates engineers, service coordinators, helpdesk staff, OEMs and subcontractors. The role also contributes operational insight to renewals, pricing, service design, fleet optimization and account growth. Success means reliable service across multiple locations, fast and effective incident resolution, controlled cost-to-serve, accurate meter-based billing and strong contract retention. This is an on-site Dubai role requiring frequent travel and occasional availability outside standard hours for critical escalations. Key Responsibilities Own daily delivery of MPS contracts across the managed fleet, using monitoring and print-management tools such as PrintFleet, FMAudit or PaperCut to identify risks early and protect uptime, response and resolution SLAs. Coordinate field engineers, helpdesk teams and consumables replenishment so toner, parts and technical support reach customers quickly, minimizing device downtime, operational disruption and avoidable SLA breaches. Lead major incidents and escalations through structured communication, root-cause analysis and corrective action plans, ensuring customer impact is contained and recurring service failures are permanently reduced. Govern contractual delivery, including cost-per-page billing, meter-reading accuracy, service scope and consumables fulfilment, while controlling revenue leakage and cost-to-serve against account and portfolio expectations. Conduct service and business reviews with key accounts, reporting SLA, uptime, first-time-fix, MTTR, CSAT or NPS performance and agreeing improvement actions that strengthen retention and renewal readiness. Lead, coach and performance-manage engineers, coordinators and helpdesk staff; plan manpower, capability development and deployment in line with fleet growth, OEM technology changes and service demand. Partner with the GM, Sales, Finance and Supply Chain on renewals, amendments, pricing, service design, fleet refresh and expansion opportunities, converting operational insight into protected revenue and account growth. Coordinate OEMs including HP, Canon, Xerox, Konica Minolta and Ricoh, plus third-party providers, while maintaining compliance with environmental, health and safety, data security and operational standards. Essential Skills & Technologies Strong knowledge of Managed Print Services, print and imaging devices, major OEM ecosystems, fleet monitoring and print-management platforms such as PrintFleet, FMAudit and PaperCut. Practical command of SLA frameworks, service contracts, ITIL-based service management, incident escalation, root-cause analysis, meter billing accuracy and cost-to-serve or P&L controls. Analytical and commercially aware, with proficiency in Excel, MS Office, dashboards, MIS reporting and exposure to CRM or ticketing systems for operational and customer performance management. Strong leadership capability across multi-location field service, helpdesk and coordination teams, including workforce planning, coaching, performance management and conflict resolution. Excellent English communication and senior stakeholder engagement skills, with confidence presenting service performance, negotiating corrective actions and managing enterprise customer escalations. Valid driving licence and willingness to travel frequently to customer sites and branch locations across the assigned region. Additional Plus Experience supporting contract renewals, amendments, renegotiations, pricing decisions or new-business proposals through operational analysis and service-design input. Exposure to process automation, standardization, continuous improvement, environmental requirements, health and safety controls or data-security practices within field-service operations. Experience managing OEM warranty claims, subcontractors and third-party service partners across distributed customer environments. What You'll Bring You will bring 5–8 years of experience in Managed Print Services, IT, office automation or related field-service and support operations, including 3–4 years in a service delivery leadership role. You should have a proven record managing multi-location teams and enterprise or large-account service contracts. You will combine operational discipline with commercial awareness. You can translate fleet, ticketing, billing and customer data into decisions that improve uptime, first-time-fix, MTTR, SLA compliance, customer satisfaction and profitability. You understand how service quality influences renewals, churn, account expansion and revenue leakage. You will be comfortable leading engineers, coordinators and helpdesk staff while coordinating OEMs, subcontractors, Sales, Finance and Supply Chain. You communicate clearly in English, remain composed during escalations and create accountability through measurable actions. You should be willing to work on-site in Dubai, travel regularly to customer and branch locations, and provide flexibility beyond standard hours when critical incidents require leadership. A valid driving licence is preferred, along with practical experience using Excel, MIS dashboards, CRM, ticketing and print-management platforms. Why Join Us Own a business-critical service portfolio where operational decisions directly influence customer retention, contract revenue, profitability and future account growth across a distributed Managed Print Services environment. Work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams while shaping service improvements, fleet optimization, renewal support and scalable operating practices across customers, branches and technology partners. Join a performance-focused team that values customer ownership, measurable outcomes, continuous improvement and practical problem-solving in a role with meaningful operational visibility and influence. What We Offer Medical insurance coverage for the employee, supporting access to healthcare as part of the overall employment package. Life insurance coverage for the employee, providing additional financial protection and reassurance. An attractive commission structure that rewards contribution to service excellence, account retention, revenue protection and growth outcomes. A leadership opportunity in Dubai with broad ownership across field service, helpdesk, consumables, customer relationships, OEM coordination and operational improvement.

review_candidates.title: Physical Products Engineer (Beds)
review_candidates.description: Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry? We are Emma – The Sleep Company . Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. Ready to awaken your best with us? What you'll do: Own physical product development projects for our Beds portfolio across Europe, APAC and LATAM - from concept through to production Work hands-on in SolidWorks (or equivalent 3D modelling tools) to design, iterate and validate physical products Run project management and steering across the full development cycle, keeping timelines and stakeholders aligned Manage product testing with external testing institutes and act on the results Work directly with suppliers and manage relationships across our global manufacturing network Collaborate closely with Category Management, Strategic Procurement, Quality, Production and Planning Drive the diversification of our Beds category across APAC and LATAM markets Who we are looking for: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing/Production or Design Engineering 2+ years of hands-on experience developing physical products - not software product management Working proficiency in SolidWorks or an equivalent 3D modelling tool Strong project management and time management skills - you keep multiple projects moving without being chased Clear, concise communication and the ability to collaborate across functions and regions The drive to learn a new domain from the ground up - nobody arrives already knowing beds and foam, and we will teach you Fluent English. Conversational Mandarin is a plus, but it is not a requirement What we offer: The opportunity to create real impact, take ownership and accountability, and drive meaningful change Continuous learning and development through hands-on experience, mentoring, formal training, and access to tools such as our Learning Hub and Nilo A collaborative community of smart, driven people where you learn, contribute, and connect, every day and through team events A global environment, working daily with diverse perspectives across 4 offices and 70+ nationalities. 25 vacations days per year, with 1 extra day per year worked (until a limit of 30 days per year) A flexible hybrid setup with up to 22 remote days per quarter, and offices in Gutleutviertel - Frankfurt Become an Emmie We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible. variance analysis (actual vs. budget) and surface insights that drive action Track and report on SaaS-specific metrics: MRR/ARR, churn, LTV, CAC, payback period, and net dollar retention Prepare leadership financial reporting and dashboards that tell a clear story Run scenario modeling as a monthly rhythm — including reverse-engineered analyses like "what would we have to believe to hit [a initiatives and long-range planning across the business Controllership & Accounting Own the monthly close process end-to-end, ensuring accurate and timely financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) Manage revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15, including deferred revenue, chargebacks, cancellations, and prior-period adjustments Oversee billing platform operations (ChargeBee and Stripe), becoming the in-house expert on how subscription data flows into the general ledger Manage our bookkeeper to ensure accurate day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and general ledger activity Maintain audit-readiness and coordinate with external tax advisors on annual compliance Build and document internal controls appropriate for our size and stage Process & dashboards, standardized templates, and narrative commentary into a clear, leadership-ready story that drives resource reallocation decisions Content Investment Analysis: Build a financial framework for evaluating content spend ROI — linking content production costs to subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention to help the content team prioritize where to invest Product Squad Cost-to-Value review_candidates.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Causal & Decision Systems
review_candidates.description: CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs. Reports to: CTO Location: Hybrid- Toronto, ON About The Role CSC Generation is building closed-loop decision systems that use machine learning to operate consumer businesses more intelligently. We are starting with pricing and expanding into areas such as inventory, purchasing, promotions, marketing, and assortment. You will help build systems that estimate causal response and quantify uncertainty, choose actions, generate useful information, observe outcomes, update policies, evaluate challengers, and deploy within guardrails. We want to answer questions such as: What happens because we change a price , rather than simply what happens next? How should uncertainty affect a decision? When should the system exploit what it knows versus experiment to learn? Can we estimate the value of a challenger policy before fully deploying it? How do we optimize economic outcomes while respecting inventory, margin, vendor, customer, and operational constraints? What You'll Do Depending on your background, you may work across: Causal and heterogeneous treatment-effect modeling Uncertainty estimation and calibration Contextual bandits, active learning, or sequential decision-making Policy learning and constrained optimization Counterfactual and off-policy evaluation Experimentation and champion/challenger systems Production ML infrastructure, monitoring, and automated deployment We care about selecting the right method, not using a particular framework. What Success Looks Like Success is not a better offline metric. The systems you build should produce measurable economic lift in controlled experiments, generalize across businesses, learn from their own interventions, and safely automate an increasing share of real commercial decisions. Over time, the goal is simple: the system should become better at operating the business because it has operated the business. What We're Looking For We care more about exceptional technical ability and judgment than matching a checklist. Strong candidates will have experience in several of: Machine learning and statistical modeling Causal inference and experimentation Recommendation, advertising, pricing, marketplace, credit, or other decision systems Bandits, reinforcement learning, optimization, or active learning Uncertainty estimation Counterfactual evaluation Production ML systems Python, SQL, and large behavioral datasets Why This Role Is Different Most ML systems learn from a dataset. Here, the decisions made by the model influence the data the model sees next. That creates a continuous loop: decision, intervention, outcome, learning, better decision. The long-term opportunity is to build that capability once and apply it across a portfolio of businesses and increasingly broad commercial decisions. Real-world impact. The systems you build will run live commercial decisions across a portfolio of consumer brands, so you will see measurable economic outcomes from your work, not just offline benchmark improvements. Technical growth at the frontier. Causal decision systems that learn from their own interventions are still an open problem. You will work at the intersection of causal ML, bandit algorithms, and production engineering, with the latitude to choose the right method for the problem. Full ownership. You will own problems end to end, from framing and modeling through production deployment and evaluation. Competitive benefits. Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage; RRSP matching; paid time off; and access to cross-brand employee discounts across the CSC Generation portfolio. Interview Process Recruiter Screen: A conversation with our recruiting team to cover your background, the role, and mutual fit. Virtual Interview Rounds: Focused discussion with the hiring manager & deeper conversations with cross-functional engineering and data science collaborators covering technical depth, system design, and working style. In-Person Interview: A final on-site visit at our Toronto office to meet the broader team and connect with key stakeholders. Reference Checks: Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible. Offer: We move quickly for the right candidate. Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be shared promptly and clearly. Please Note Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately. Due to a high volume of fraudulent applications, you must share a valid LinkedIn profile URL in the application questions below to be considered. If you do not have a LinkedIn profile, you must provide a credible reason in that field and supply alternative evidence of your professional background to verify your identity. The CSC Generation family of brands is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please contact [email protected] . For Ontario applicants, please note that this posting is for an existing vacancy. Job Description Reporting to the Project Controls Lead, the Project Controls Specialist owns the integrated project controls function — uniting cost control and planning/scheduling into a single, coherent view of project performance. The successful candidate will maintain the cost-loaded master schedule, manage budgets and forecasting, apply Earned Value Management (EVM) across both cost and schedule, and translate complex data into clear, actionable insight for project leadership and stakeholders. Schedule Integration: Ensure compliance and execution of sub-trade and partner schedules, directing full integration and coordination across all project schedules, including scope-specific schedules for bid packages. Resource & Progress Management: Oversee resource allocation and leveling; validate weekly and monthly progress against baseline and milestones, and develop recovery schedules and mitigation plans as required. Collaborative Planning: Contribute to Target Value Design and collaborative (pull / last-planner) planning sessions within IPD and lean delivery environments. Cost Control Cost Engineering & Budget Management: Own budget formulation, cost coding, commitment tracking, and cost-to-complete forecasting, maintaining strict fiscal discipline across the project lifecycle. Cash Flow & Forecasting: Develop and maintain cash flow forecasts, contingency and management-reserve tracking, and contingency draw analysis Commercial & Procurement Alignment: Interface with commercial, procurement, and finance teams to align commitments, progress billings, subcontractor evaluations, and final forecasting. Integrated Performance, Change & Risk Earned Value Management: Establish and maintain EVM baselines, measure cost and schedule performance (CPI/SPI), analyze variances, and recommend corrective actions. Change Management: Assess the cumulative cost and schedule impacts of trends, scope variances, and field changes through the change control process, including delay analysis appropriate to the contract type. Risk Analysis: Participate in risk register reviews and quantitative cost and schedule risk assessments to identify and proactively address exposure and bottlenecks. Reporting & Analytics: Compile and distribute project controls reports, dashboards, and executive KPIs, translating complex cost and schedule data into clear, actionable insights. Stakeholder Engagement: Organize and lead project controls, planning, and scheduling meetings with internal teams, trade partners, and owner representatives On-Site Validation: Perform on-site data validation during scheduled on-site rotations to ensure the accuracy and integrity of reported cost and progress. Qualifications Education: Diploma or degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Architectural Technology, Commerce, or a related technical discipline. Years of Experience: Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in project controls — spanning cost control and planning/scheduling — on large-scale capital construction projects. Professional Certifications: Certified Cost Professional (CCP), Planning & Scheduling Professional (PSP), Project Management Professional (PMP), or Gold Seal designations are considered an asset. Technical Competencies: Strong command of Earned Value Management (EVM), cost/schedule integration, critical-path scheduling, resource loading and leveling, cost forecasting, cash flow modeling, work breakdown structures (WBS), delay analysis, and quantitative risk analysis. Software Knowledge: Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and advanced Microsoft Excel for financial modeling; Microsoft Project, Power BI for data visualization, and project cost-management/ERP systems are considered assets. Industry Experience: Experience on complex industrial, institutional, government, or heavy-civil projects. Communication & Stakeholder Skills: Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to constructively challenge assumptions and present cost and schedule metrics clearly to project, owner, and executive stakeholders. Work arrangement: This is a hybrid position with a rotational on-site requirement (a minimum of three days on-site OR as required by the client, depending on project assignment), with the balance of time worked remotely. Travel and living allowances are provided to cover boarding and lodging for on-site rotations. On-site periods support cost and progress validation, collaborative planning sessions, and stakeholder coordination; remote periods support analysis, schedule maintenance, forecasting, and reporting Additional Information Chandos is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture and this includes our recruitment and hiring process. We talk about being an entrepreneurial-minded organization and you can be sure we mean it! Competitive wages Well rounded employer paid benefits program including health, dental, vision care and employee assistance program RRSP matching program to aid and prepare employees for long-term financial security Educational assistance for employees who wish to pursue job-performance enhancing education Recognition and annual salary reviews program Leadership conferences that allow employees to connect and collaborate Regular company-wide engagement opportunities Vacancy Status We are actively recruiting for this position. All hiring decisions are made by qualified human reviewers. Compensation Transparency Expected Salary: $100,000 to $130,000 CAD Annual Salary The base salary range for this role is listed above and may vary based on your experience. This position also includes a competitive bonus program. Throughout the interview process, we’ll discuss your background to determine the best alignment for your experience level.

new_matches.title: Service Delivery Lead
new_matches.description: Job Title: Service Delivery Manager – Managed Print Services (MPS) Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates Experience: 5-8 years About the Company We provide Managed Print Services that help organizations operate reliable, cost-controlled and measurable printing environments across distributed locations. Our work combines print and imaging technology, field service, helpdesk support, consumables fulfilment, fleet monitoring and commercial contract management to keep customer operations running with minimal disruption. Our teams work across customer sites, branch locations and operational support functions, partnering with major OEMs and internal Sales, Finance and Supply Chain stakeholders. We focus on dependable service delivery, accurate billing, responsive escalation management and continuous improvement because these levers protect customer trust, contract revenue and long-term account value. We are building a service culture that values ownership, clear communication, data-led decisions and practical problem-solving. The successful candidate will join a customer-focused environment where strong operational execution directly supports retention, profitability, renewals and growth. The role is based in Dubai and includes regular travel to customer and branch locations. About the Role The Service Delivery Manager owns end-to-end operational performance across the assigned Managed Print Services install base. Through field service, helpdesk, consumables, monitoring tools and escalation controls, the role protects device uptime, SLA compliance, billing accuracy and customer satisfaction. Reporting to the General Manager – Revenue & Service Delivery, the manager leads service delivery teams and coordinates engineers, service coordinators, helpdesk staff, OEMs and subcontractors. The role also contributes operational insight to renewals, pricing, service design, fleet optimization and account growth. Success means reliable service across multiple locations, fast and effective incident resolution, controlled cost-to-serve, accurate meter-based billing and strong contract retention. This is an on-site Dubai role requiring frequent travel and occasional availability outside standard hours for critical escalations. Key Responsibilities Own daily delivery of MPS contracts across the managed fleet, using monitoring and print-management tools such as PrintFleet, FMAudit or PaperCut to identify risks early and protect uptime, response and resolution SLAs. Coordinate field engineers, helpdesk teams and consumables replenishment so toner, parts and technical support reach customers quickly, minimizing device downtime, operational disruption and avoidable SLA breaches. Lead major incidents and escalations through structured communication, root-cause analysis and corrective action plans, ensuring customer impact is contained and recurring service failures are permanently reduced. Govern contractual delivery, including cost-per-page billing, meter-reading accuracy, service scope and consumables fulfilment, while controlling revenue leakage and cost-to-serve against account and portfolio expectations. Conduct service and business reviews with key accounts, reporting SLA, uptime, first-time-fix, MTTR, CSAT or NPS performance and agreeing improvement actions that strengthen retention and renewal readiness. Lead, coach and performance-manage engineers, coordinators and helpdesk staff; plan manpower, capability development and deployment in line with fleet growth, OEM technology changes and service demand. Partner with the GM, Sales, Finance and Supply Chain on renewals, amendments, pricing, service design, fleet refresh and expansion opportunities, converting operational insight into protected revenue and account growth. Coordinate OEMs including HP, Canon, Xerox, Konica Minolta and Ricoh, plus third-party providers, while maintaining compliance with environmental, health and safety, data security and operational standards. Essential Skills & Technologies Strong knowledge of Managed Print Services, print and imaging devices, major OEM ecosystems, fleet monitoring and print-management platforms such as PrintFleet, FMAudit and PaperCut. Practical command of SLA frameworks, service contracts, ITIL-based service management, incident escalation, root-cause analysis, meter billing accuracy and cost-to-serve or P&L controls. Analytical and commercially aware, with proficiency in Excel, MS Office, dashboards, MIS reporting and exposure to CRM or ticketing systems for operational and customer performance management. Strong leadership capability across multi-location field service, helpdesk and coordination teams, including workforce planning, coaching, performance management and conflict resolution. Excellent English communication and senior stakeholder engagement skills, with confidence presenting service performance, negotiating corrective actions and managing enterprise customer escalations. Valid driving licence and willingness to travel frequently to customer sites and branch locations across the assigned region. Additional Plus Experience supporting contract renewals, amendments, renegotiations, pricing decisions or new-business proposals through operational analysis and service-design input. Exposure to process automation, standardization, continuous improvement, environmental requirements, health and safety controls or data-security practices within field-service operations. Experience managing OEM warranty claims, subcontractors and third-party service partners across distributed customer environments. What You'll Bring You will bring 5–8 years of experience in Managed Print Services, IT, office automation or related field-service and support operations, including 3–4 years in a service delivery leadership role. You should have a proven record managing multi-location teams and enterprise or large-account service contracts. You will combine operational discipline with commercial awareness. You can translate fleet, ticketing, billing and customer data into decisions that improve uptime, first-time-fix, MTTR, SLA compliance, customer satisfaction and profitability. You understand how service quality influences renewals, churn, account expansion and revenue leakage. You will be comfortable leading engineers, coordinators and helpdesk staff while coordinating OEMs, subcontractors, Sales, Finance and Supply Chain. You communicate clearly in English, remain composed during escalations and create accountability through measurable actions. You should be willing to work on-site in Dubai, travel regularly to customer and branch locations, and provide flexibility beyond standard hours when critical incidents require leadership. A valid driving licence is preferred, along with practical experience using Excel, MIS dashboards, CRM, ticketing and print-management platforms. Why Join Us Own a business-critical service portfolio where operational decisions directly influence customer retention, contract revenue, profitability and future account growth across a distributed Managed Print Services environment. Work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams while shaping service improvements, fleet optimization, renewal support and scalable operating practices across customers, branches and technology partners. Join a performance-focused team that values customer ownership, measurable outcomes, continuous improvement and practical problem-solving in a role with meaningful operational visibility and influence. What We Offer Medical insurance coverage for the employee, supporting access to healthcare as part of the overall employment package. Life insurance coverage for the employee, providing additional financial protection and reassurance. An attractive commission structure that rewards contribution to service excellence, account retention, revenue protection and growth outcomes. A leadership opportunity in Dubai with broad ownership across field service, helpdesk, consumables, customer relationships, OEM coordination and operational improvement.

new_matches.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Causal & Decision Systems
new_matches.description: CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs. Reports to: CTO Location: Hybrid- Toronto, ON About The Role CSC Generation is building closed-loop decision systems that use machine learning to operate consumer businesses more intelligently. We are starting with pricing and expanding into areas such as inventory, purchasing, promotions, marketing, and assortment. You will help build systems that estimate causal response and quantify uncertainty, choose actions, generate useful information, observe outcomes, update policies, evaluate challengers, and deploy within guardrails. We want to answer questions such as: What happens because we change a price , rather than simply what happens next? How should uncertainty affect a decision? When should the system exploit what it knows versus experiment to learn? Can we estimate the value of a challenger policy before fully deploying it? How do we optimize economic outcomes while respecting inventory, margin, vendor, customer, and operational constraints? What You'll Do Depending on your background, you may work across: Causal and heterogeneous treatment-effect modeling Uncertainty estimation and calibration Contextual bandits, active learning, or sequential decision-making Policy learning and constrained optimization Counterfactual and off-policy evaluation Experimentation and champion/challenger systems Production ML infrastructure, monitoring, and automated deployment We care about selecting the right method, not using a particular framework. What Success Looks Like Success is not a better offline metric. The systems you build should produce measurable economic lift in controlled experiments, generalize across businesses, learn from their own interventions, and safely automate an increasing share of real commercial decisions. Over time, the goal is simple: the system should become better at operating the business because it has operated the business. What We're Looking For We care more about exceptional technical ability and judgment than matching a checklist.
